pattern: Germany's electric-car market grew (\d+)% in January

label: Lede: period year
pattern: in January–September (\d{4}), but
formula: lastMonth().slice(5) === '09' ? lastMonth().slice(0,4) : 'data no longer ends in September'

label: Lede: biggest loser named
pattern: but (VW Group)'s share fell

label: Lede: VW Group this year

pattern: as (Tesla, Chinese brands and Stellantis) took share
formula: units('gain',3).map(u => ({'VW GROUP':'VW Group','CHINESE BRANDS':'Chinese brands','STELLANTIS':'Stellantis','TESLA':'Tesla','RENAULT GROUP':'Renault Group','MERCEDES-BENZ':'Mercedes-Benz'})[u] || u).join(', ').replace(/, ([^,]*)$/, ' and $1')

pattern: Of the German premium makers, only Mercedes-Benz gained; BMW Group and Porsche lost\.

label: Chart image
pattern: !\[Share of German battery-electric registrations by owner group, this year against last\]\(docs/screenshots/chart-groups\.png\)

label: F1 heading
pattern: \*\*VW Group grew, but far slower than the market\.\*\*
formula: cun('VW GROUP',lastMonth().slice(0,4)) > cun('VW GROUP',String(+lastMonth().slice(0,4)-1)) && 100 * (cun('VW GROUP',lastMonth().slice(0,4)) / cun('VW GROUP',String(+lastMonth().slice(0,4)-1)) - 1) < 0.5 * growth('MARKET', lastMonth().slice(0,4)) ? '' : 'claim false'

label: F1: VW added cars
pattern: It registered ([\d,]+) more electric cars than a year earlier

label: F1: VW growth
pattern: than a year earlier, (\d+)% more, while the market grew

label: F1: market growth
pattern: while the market grew (\d+)%; had it grown as fast as the market, its share would have held

label: F1: self-registration test
pattern: The result holds after removing cars that makers and their dealers registered themselves

label: F1: noise test
pattern: each named change is larger than month-to-month noise

label: F2 heading
pattern: \*\*Mercedes-Benz gained with two new models\.\*\*

label: F2: Mercedes share gain
pattern: Its share rose ([\d.]+) points\.

pattern: The CLA and the electric GLC added ([\d,]+) electric cars
formula: mdelta('MERCEDES')[0][0] === 'CLA-KLASSE' && mdelta('MERCEDES')[1][0] === 'GLK, GLC' ? mdelta('MERCEDES')[0][1] + mdelta('MERCEDES')[1][1] : 'not the two largest'

label: F2: more than whole increase
pattern: electric cars, more than the brand's whole increase, while its older electric models fell

label: F2: BMW Group loss
pattern: BMW Group lost ([\d.]+) points

label: F2: Porsche loss
pattern: points and Porsche ([\d.]+)\.

label: F3 heading
pattern: \*\*The lift after the bonus was fully electric\.\*\*

label: F3: bonus date (fact bonus26_open)
pattern: After the bonus opened on (\d+ May)

label: F3: BEV difference-in-differences
pattern: battery-electric registrations grew (\d+) percentage points faster than before, measured against diesel as a control

label: F3: PHEV difference-in-differences
pattern: barely moved \(\+([\d.]+)\)

label: F3: timing
pattern: The timing fits the bonus; it does not prove it\.

label: F4 heading
pattern: \*\*Who gained most depends on one classification\.\*\*
formula: dsh('STELLANTIS INCL. LEAPMOTOR') > Math.max(...units('gain', 20).filter(u => !['STELLANTIS','CHINESE BRANDS'].includes(u)).map(u => dsh(u))) && dsh('CHINESE BRANDS') > dsh('STELLANTIS') ? '' : 'claim false'

label: F4: Leapmotor JV (quoted in SOURCES.md)
pattern: Leapmotor is a Chinese brand, but Stellantis controls its European sales through a joint venture

label: F4: Chinese gain incl. Leapmotor
pattern: Counted as Chinese, the Chinese brands gained ([\d.]+) points

label: F4: Stellantis incl. Leapmotor
pattern: counted under Stellantis, Stellantis gained ([\d.]+) points and becomes the largest gainer

label: F4: Chinese excl. Leapmotor
pattern: and the Chinese brands gained ([\d.]+)\.

label: Definitions
pattern: Definitions: KBA registrations, January to September of each year\. "Electric" means battery-electric; a "share" is a group's part of all German electric registrations; "Chinese brands" are brands of carmakers headquartered in China \(list in the README\)\.
formula: lastMonth().slice(5) === '09' ? '' : 'memo says January to September but the data ends in another month'
